reproducibility_gaps: No repository license is identified in final Stage-2 authority.
The README pins JAX 0.3.25 but no complete dependency/environment manifest is present.
No repository installation procedure is provided.
Seed provenance is not established by the bounded repository-level inspection.
Hardware requirements/provenance are not established by the bounded repository-level inspection.
Bundled trained parameter/loss artifacts are present but lack a unified repository manifest tying every artifact to a fully specified portable environment and evaluation target.
Bundled data/generators are repository research artifacts rather than an independently versioned reusable dataset release.
notes: R2 reflects a verified pinned source repository with explicit notebook entrypoints, bundled data/generators, trained artifacts and a partially pinned JAX requirement, while environment/install/version/provenance gates remain incomplete. R3/R4 are not justified.
